title: SyncCycleStarted.v1
description: Emitted at the start of `SyncEngine.runSyncCycle()`. Pairs with SyncCycleSucceeded.v1 or SyncCycleFailed.v1 via cycleId. Push-eligible so postmortems can correlate which session synced what.

cycleId.description: UUID generated at cycle start; correlates with end events.
